results.Summary: Jayco, Inc. (Jayco) is recalling certain 2015-2020 Seneca Class C motorhomes.  The mounting brackets for the leveling system hydraulic pump and reservoir may fail, allowing the components to contact the ground.
results.Consequence: Contact with the ground may cause the pump and reservoir to detach or leak hydraulic fluids, increasing the risk of a crash.
results.Remedy: Jayco will notify owners, and dealers will install an updated support bracket.  The recall began February 12, 2021.  Owners may contact Jayco customer service at 1-800-283-8267.  Jayco's number for this recall is 9903529.
results.Notes: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.safercar.gov.
